title: Press an overfull case's lid shut with one hand while the other pulls its zip closed
instruction: Press the overfull case's lid shut with one hand and with the other pull the zip by its red pull ring from the front end all the way to the back.
context: Closing an overfull suitcase or bag is a familiar two-handed job at home, in hotels and in luggage handling: one hand presses the lid down so that the zip's two sides meet, while the other pulls the zip along. A zip jams where its two sides do not meet.
setup: A table in front of two arms (bases 61 cm apart), seen by one overhead camera and a camera on each wrist. Distances are measured forward from the line between the arm bases and sideways from the midpoint between them. A fixed dark blue fabric carry case, 26 cm from front to back and 30 cm wide, its body 6 cm tall, centred 28 cm forward and 0.5 cm left. Its lid, 24 cm wide and 2 cm thick, is hinged along the case's left top edge and pushed up about 7 degrees by what is packed inside (its free right edge about 3 cm up). Beside the lid, along the case's right side, a 6 cm ledge carries the zip, 13.3 cm right of the centre line, running from 17 cm forward back to 39 cm forward; its slider waits at the front end with a red pull ring standing 3.5 cm tall (1.8 cm long, 8 mm thick). The layout is the same in every trial, as in the screenshot.
scoring: Judged at the end of the trial. The zip runs only while the lid's free edge is within 3 mm of shut; otherwise its slider jams. Once it is 30% of the way along, the zip holds the lid shut by itself. 1.0: the zip pulled at least 95% of the way to the back end, with the lid shut (within 1 degree); 0.5: pulled at least half way; 0.25: at least a tenth of the way; else 0.0. The trial ends at the run limit, or once the full score has held with the zip still for 1 s.
reset_notes: Pull the zip back to the front end; the lid springs back up.
fidelity: Rigid-body simulation (Isaac Sim 6.1, PhysX, 20 Hz control). Simplified: the case is rigid and fixed; the overfull contents are a spring in the lid's hinge (about 6 N pressing 12 cm from the hinge holds the lid shut). The zip is a slider on a straight track: the task file jams it while the lid's edge is more than 3 mm up and, once 30% is zipped, holds the lid shut. No fabric or zip teeth. Cameras 1280 x 704 (Dream-1 sees 320 x 176).
